observations.behavior: Adds a customer-fan-out iterator that paginates customers and issues one child API call per customer, with checkpoint-based resumption.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects warehouse ingestion to Autumn's nested resource model; PostHog can now ingest license pools without missing rows or duplicating on restart.

observations.behavior: Routed the fan-out path through the source factory, returning early when customer_fan_out is set rather than using generic request building.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes the new multi-step ingestion available as an endpoint configuration in Warehouse Sources, not just ad-hoc code.

observations.behavior: Adds tests for pagination, resume skipping deleted customers, and repeated cursor failure. No exceptions are raised if behavior matches expectations.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection against infinite loops and lost data during incremental syncs of this connector.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks were examined; no review of other potential hunks or complete implementation. Tier assignment relies solely on these observations.

review.limitations: Only three hunks were examined; no review of other potential hunks or complete implementation. Tier assignment relies solely on these observations.
review.reason: The change adds a bounded capability: a resumable, customer-scoped fan-out pattern for warehouse ingestion. This is substantive but does not demonstrate broader systemic risk reduction across multiple connectors or critical paths.
review.posthog_relevance: Allows Warehouse Sources to correctly ingest nested resources (licenses) from Autumn while preserving checkpoint recovery and preventing duplicate or skipped records.
review.uncertainty: Assessment depends only on supplied chunk; unreviewed hunks could reveal additional changes that would raise tier.
